provenance: Compiled from organisation guideline indices and PubMed. Every record was checked against a primary source. Fields marked confidence:'unconfirmed_pmid' have a verified DOI/journal but an unverified PMID and MUST NOT be emitted as a [PMID:N] citation until resolved.
ingest_notes: A guideline is NOT a paper. Do not place these on the study-design tier ladder. They occupy a parallel channel keyed by 'authority', not by 'tier'.

Several of these ARE PubMed-indexed and will therefore already be entering the corpus as if they were primary studies. Ingesting this manifest must DEDUPE against the existing paper table by PMID and reclassify those rows as guidelines.
The single most valuable field here is 'superseded_by'. A superseded guideline cited as current is a clinical hazard, not a formatting defect.
'jurisdiction' matters: NICE/SDCEP/CGDent bind UK practice; AAE/ADA/AAOMS are US. A UK clinician given only US guidance has been given the wrong answer.

known_defects_this_manifest_closes: The bare key '(ESE-QG-2023)' leaking into Literature citation slots resolves to ESE-QG-2006, which is SUPERSEDED — the leaked key was also wrong about the year.
The bare key '[PMID AAE-PS-diagnosis]' leaking into Case citation slots resolves to AAE-DIAGNOSIS-2009.

PMID 41121563 and PMID 40533920 are already in the corpus as papers. They are the AAPD permanent-teeth VPT guideline and its supporting review. Reclassifying them explains why a paediatric guideline anchored a mature-permanent-teeth curriculum at score 80.0.
EFCD-ESE-ORCA-DEEPCARIES-2026 (PMID 42018467) is the guideline the VPT curriculum missed entirely.

Three Cochrane reviews in the endodontic space are WITHDRAWN (CD007997, CD005408, CD004623). Cochrane sits at the top of the tier ladder; a withdrawn review cited as top-tier evidence is a clinical-safety defect.
